div.head: Leis Wl 45.2
div.ab: E si testimonie ad, si cum nous einz desimes, voest les treis f[e]iz e a la quart[e] feiz le dereinet u il le rende.

And if he has witnesses in accordance with what we have declared above, vouching to warranty shall take place three times; and on the fourth occasion he shall prove his ownership of it or deliver it up.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 272–273 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
